extract_prompt_completion: extract the prompt string from completion API call data containing messages and tool_calls
extract_prompt_acompletion: extract the prompt string from async completion API call data with text and multimodal message content
extract_prompt_embedding: extract the prompt string from embedding API call data supporting str or list input formats
extract_prompt_audio_transcription: extract the prompt string from audio transcription API call data when a prompt field is present
extract_prompt_image_generation: extract the prompt string from image generation API call data using the prompt field
